title: Fun or frightful? Halloween Advent calendars hit the shelves
summary: Retailers stock up on countdown gifts as Britain’s enthusiasm for (and spending on) spooky holiday grows It is the stuff of nightmares if you think Christmas is too commercial: the Halloween Advent calendar is here. In this version of advent the countdown spans 13 (unlucky for some) to 31 “nights of fright” and is meted out in everything from horror dolls to KPop Demon Hunter keyrings. Continue reading...
